verdict.rationale: Semgrep's rule-writing docs say rules can "scan configuration files," and generic pattern matching covers languages it does not natively support. A community report also notes YAML parsing. This suggests IaC misconfiguration checks are possible, but the evidence never names Terraform, Kubernetes or IaC rulesets, so it likely depends on custom rules. Missing for 10: explicit Terraform/HCL and Kubernetes manifest support, prebuilt IaC misconfiguration rulesets, documentation of IaC-specific checks, independent or hands-on corroboration of IaC scanning.
